s01584.summary: Lady Evelyn pours tea and spars wittily with young solicitor Julian over sugar and flattery.
Julian raises the Hargreaves offer for the east orchard; Evelyn parries and sizes him up.
Evelyn hints something is buried beneath the fourth pear tree and deflects with biscuits.
Evelyn refuses to sell the orchard, calling it sentimental; Julian warns the firm will persist.
They smile and share another cup of tea as rain falls.

s00629.summary: Devon waits at the quiet hospice station while Grace answers a call about his father.
Devon admits he is not ready; Grace urges him to go in and be Walter.
Devon asks if it gets easier; Grace says no, you get kinder, and he goes.
Leonidas joyfully greets Walter from down the hall as Grace quietly logs the time.

s02480.summary: Luciana waits in the bay; Deacon joins her and she announces her three hundred shots.
Over the PA the coach wants her out; Deacon pushes her to admit she is out of the lineup.
Luciana pulls on her helmet and orders Deacon to open the door to the ice.

s00898_0.summary: Elijah sips coffee on his porch step, composing a letter to Ruth in his head.
A rider approaches; Elijah goes inside and loads his shotgun.

s01385.summary: Three exhausted soldiers hide behind a wall by the mill while Mireille watches the far bank.
Oskar and Mireille trade dry banter as the wounded soldier mutters in delirium.
Mireille orders a crossing at dark and insists they carry the wounded man.
The wounded soldier wakes lucid and begs to be left; Oskar finds he is bleeding out.
Mortar rounds destroy the wall; the soldier dies and Mireille and Oskar scramble for the river.
Under machine-gun fire they plunge into the river and vanish into the mist.

s01902.summary: Soldiers hold a salt-flat radio shack as a barefoot priest approaches waving a white rag.
The soldiers test the priest's claims; he offers a Bible and stale bread and says both armies left.
Liam's radio brings a ceasefire order already in effect; the soldiers lower their weapons.

s00924.summary: Deputy Tomas bursts in as stationmaster Zeke copies a telegram; a stranger rides up behind.
Zeke reads the wire: the Harlan gang crossed the river and orders say do not engage.
Billie reads the telegram and tells the green deputy that today he is the law.
Riders appear; Billie shoots the lead horse and the gang scatters behind the water tower.
A white handkerchief appears on a rifle barrel; someone wants to talk.

s00465.summary: Five survivors huddle by a tiny stove beside a wrecked sled as Isolde checks rations.
The compass spins uselessly and Cas asks if they are lost.
Isolde warns Wilfred his injured hand will blacken; he tucks it away.
Isolde has Temi pick a heading, east, and decides they will carry the injured dog Bramble.
They break camp; Isolde bids the broken sled farewell and leads them east.

s02274.summary: Odell, Maude and Zeb idly bicker over why the stagecoach is late.
The driver calls from afar that the axle broke; they accept another night and ask about stew.

s01544_0.summary: Wounded Colette levels an empty pistol at Cass over the body of Nestor.
Nestor coughs awake, causing a clumsy collision, and turns out to be alive.
With the dish broken, Nestor proposes uploading by hand from a basement transmitter, despite mines.
Colette tosses Cass the drive and the trio help Nestor toward the stairwell.

s02209.summary: Alone in a secret shipyard rowing tank, Naomi rows her single scull at dawn.
Coach Vorhees appears at the dock, Naomi falters, and her time is disappointing.
On the dock Vorhees reminds her Beijing is eleven weeks away and she rows like she has forgotten.
Naomi tells her coach she is done and cannot do it anymore.
Vorhees admits she faked the splits since March because Naomi needed someone to lie to her.
Sun breaks, Naomi laughs and weeps, and they agree to row again.

s01288.summary: Inspector Holt questions nervous archivist Lowe about a bloodstained umbrella found on the tracks.
Holt tells Lowe he thinks he is afraid, mentioning a man found injured in a signal box.
Magda emerges from the dark claiming the umbrella and contradicts Lowe about knowing him.
Holt asks whose name is on the ticket stub; both deny it as an umbrella falls in the dark.

s00215.summary: Marcus finds drawer fourteen occupied by a body identical to the one on his gurney.
Hildegard drags reluctant guard Eugene to look; they offer twins as an explanation.
Drawers slide open on their own and Eugene recalls the dead all sat up in '98.
A hand grips drawer fourteen, the door is locked from outside, and the lights go out.
The lights return to show every drawer open and every sheet empty.

s02009.summary: Six women bustle around the panicked bride, fixing her dress, makeup and flowers amid chaos.
A radio message silences the room; Denise brightly insists all is fine, then admits the groom wants a word.
The bride hands over her veil and quietly leaves to see the groom.

s00275.summary: Gretchen is stuck in the windmill tunnel retrieving her ball while Russ protests.
A blade clips Waldo's hat and Gretchen shoots out, toppling all three in a heap.

s00516.summary: Judge Harriet convenes court in a dark, powerless courtroom by conference phone.
Quigley asks for a continuance because of the outage; Harriet denies it.
Harriet orders Quigley to bring his seventy-eight-year-old client up eleven flights of stairs.
Harriet softens, telling him to take thirty minutes, and waits in the dark.

s02030.summary: Five people taste cheese around a table in the cave, with unease beneath the ritual.
Tomas refuses the cheese; Sabine sets down her knife and Leilani pours Yosef too much wine.
Arnaud muses that things in the cave turn into what they were always going to be.
Tomas's jacket falls open revealing a holster; everyone sees, nobody speaks, and Arnaud turns to business.

s02286.summary: A large man in the 24-hour laundromat complains that a broken dryer took his quarters.
He approaches the dryer; Nikolai warns him off, and the man yanks it open.
Cash spills from the dryer and Nikolai lunges; the tall man shoves him into the table.
Marcus reveals himself as police and the three accuse each other over the money.

s01957.summary: Three thieves find the black-wax wheel in the cheese cave and crack out a steel case.
Rhiannon, the night watch, appears; Luca hands over the case and learns she knew.
Brodie asks if they are fired; Rhiannon says they were never hired.

s00234.summary: Three soldiers watch a shelled farmhouse, trading wary remarks on how quiet it is.
The farmhouse door is ajar; the squad rises with rifles up and three goats walk out.
Relief turns to laughter among the soldiers at the goats.
A shell whistles in and explodes in the barn; the radio is dead and they take cover.

s02255.summary: Agent Torvald demands the crew open a van on the ferry deck while they argue about his warrant.
Torvald opens the van and finds crates of cash hidden under straw.
Beatrix claims the cargo and draws a pistol, telling Torvald to step away.
Colm offers coffee and clangs a pan on her wrist; the crew subdues her.

s01182.summary: Stranded passengers in a swaying gondola get dispatch's order to hold position; Tariq snaps.
The light dies and Elspeth orders everyone to pool warm clothing and supplies.
Dispatch warns of a storm in forty minutes; Elspeth wraps Mireille in a scarf and they hold on.

s02106.summary: Graciela and Bastian tend their peach stand as Otis pulls up and pays at the honesty box.
Otis leaves an extra dollar for the view and drives off; Graciela quietly pockets it.

s02157.summary: Captain Farrukh tests rookie bowler Caspian on a rooftop pitch under a new coach's eye.
The coach corrects Caspian's grip and Farrukh smashes the next ball off the roof.
She identifies herself as Ibarra and challenges Farrukh to play the last ball well.
